serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services), service_capacities reserved_minutes as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative figure from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities' own reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible, never used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row for that site/day, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until someone edits the lot; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured, not a ceiling of 0.
